usage: The word 保育 (bou2 juk6) is used as a noun to refer to the act or practice of conservation, especially related to the environment or wildlife.
It typically appears in contexts discussing environmental protection, animal preservation, and sustainable practices.
In sentences, 保育 often comes before the object it is preserving, such as 保育區 (conservation area) or 保育動物 (conserved animals).
It can be combined with verbs like 做 (to do) or 推行 (to implement) when talking about carrying out conservation efforts.
When using 保育 in speech, it's natural to use it in contexts about preserving nature, endangered species, or cultural heritage.
